notablePrerequisites:
"White" chosen with Painter's Servant.
Callous Sell-Sword does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Callous Sell-Sword persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Callous Sell-Sword, adding {C}{C}.
When Callous Sell-Sword dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Callous Sell-Sword enters the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each creature you controlled that died this turn.
Repeat.
